reason: On 4.1.7 class-mock instances simply lacked prototype methods, so working v4 code supplied its own (constructor impls returning objects or assigning this.x, prototype spies, class-field stubs, toEqual on instances) and all of these still pass unchanged on 5.0.5 (checked); only assertions that a method is missing or instanceof is false would break, which no plausible code checks.
Raised minimum Node.js and Vite versions with no API change.

The html reporter and its outputDir handling ship in @vitest/ui, a separate package outside the frame; the pinned vitest 5.0.5 never reads the option (it fails at startup with a missing @vitest/ui dependency), so the frame package doesn't behave as the entry says.

toMatchScreenshot only runs in Vitest browser mode, which needs a browser provider package (@vitest/browser-playwright or -webdriverio) and a real browser binary that the template cannot install with npm install --ignore-scripts.
